papers.title_en: RealCLI: Toward a Unified Evaluation of Human-Agent Collaboration for CLI Agents
papers.authors: Yunqi Liu, Peiyu Wang, Bingli Wang, Leo Luo, Xuanwu Song, Xudong Ma, Hongxin Li, Yaxin Du, Weicheng Gu, Fanglin Xu, Yi Xing, XiangLong Liu, Jujie He, Zhange Zhang, Huatong Song, Zhaoyi Li, Deyang Kong, Chuan Hao, Peihao Wu, Mingjie Tang, Ran Tao, Jian Yang, Wayne Xin Zhao, Bryan Dai
papers.evidence: 在交互式命令行场景中评测任务执行与实时人机协作。
papers.tldr: 现有命令行智能体评测多假设用户需求固定，并侧重最终任务结果，难以衡量执行中的人机协作质量。REALCLI以配对基准统一评估任务执行与协作，设置完整规格预先给定和脚本用户动态交互两种模式，覆盖五大维度、22个子维度及51类交互场景模板。最佳配置平均得分仅49.2%，联合协作得分最高仅37.6%。结果揭示任务效果与协作质量明显分离，为改进可引导性、信任校准和安全边界管理提供可复现的评测基础。
papers.abstract_en: Command-line interface (CLI) agents increasingly execute longer-horizon tasks, yet existing benchmarks either assume that user instructions remain fixed throughout execution or evaluate task outcomes without capturing runtime collaboration quality. In this paper, we present REALCLI, a paired benchmark that unifies the evaluation of task execution and human-agent collaboration quality on realistic CLI tasks. To comprehensively measure collaboration, REALCLI builds a five-dimensional framework, operationalized into 22 sub-dimensions and 51 interaction scenario templates. REALCLI provides two modes for paired comparison: REALCLI-EXEC supplies complete specifications upfront, whereas REALCLI-COLLAB introduces a scripted user that delivers progressive information, corrections, constraint revisions, and authorization decisions. Evaluations reveal profound capability gaps in frontier agents: the best configuration attains an average score of only 49.2%, and when evaluated by the joint collaboration score ($J_{\mathrm{collab}}$), the peak performance reaches merely 37.6%. These results show that task effectiveness diverges sharply from collaboration quality, with models consistently struggling in steerability, trust calibration, and safety boundary management. REALCLI provides a rigorous, reproducible foundation for measuring and advancing collaborative CLI agents.

papers.title_en: Principles and Techniques for Agentic Research in Experimental Physics
papers.authors: Niko R. Reed, Declan M. Daly, Andrew J. Beling, Jordan D. Giandrea, Ronald L. Walsworth, John W. Blanchard, Daniel Ang
papers.evidence: 提出以人为中心的人类与人工智能协作原则
papers.tldr: 实验物理中人工智能应用日益普及，但有效使用规范仍不完善。本文提出协作智能体的十项要求，以研究者主导并承担结果责任为前提，通过定制框架和闭环迭代组织科研任务。六个案例覆盖器件设计、硬件控制、网络优化、模型辨识与数据分析，获得可制造波导设计、模拟性能提升逾一个数量级的控制脉冲及约1赫兹精度的核磁共振调试结果。研究展示了智能体增强专家能力、产出实用科研成果的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) in physics research is increasingly common, yet few guidelines exist for its effective use. Starting with a principles-based approach, we outline a set of ten requirements for collaborative AI agents in experimental physics, spanning scientific norms, effective agent use, and domain expertise. We take a human-centered approach in which agents act as collaborators that amplify rather than replace the expertise of a human researcher (user) who directs the work and is responsible for its results. We then present a framework designed to enforce these requirements, detailing methods for improving off-the-shelf behavior of large language models (LLMs) with custom scaffolding and describing general-purpose scientific workflows and skills. In particular, we highlight the power of closed-loop campaigns where agents work iteratively toward a well-defined goal. We demonstrate the potential of this mode of research through six case studies in experimental physics, covering device design, hardware control, neural network optimization, physical model identification, and data analysis. All six case studies result in useful work products that add utility to our research, including a neural network architecture and solid-state quantum defect photodynamic model that substantially outperform our published work; a microwave waveguide design that extends a published design concept to a fabrication-ready device meeting our experimental constraints; a quantum control pulse sequence candidate that improves simulated performance by more than an order of magnitude; commissioning of an NMR spectrometer to $\sim$1~Hz frequency precision on live hardware; and finally a data-fitting pipeline that achieves, to our knowledge, the first reconstruction of the Ising microstate of an artificial spin-ice array from diffraction-limited magnetic imaging.

papers.title_en: Task-Centric Multimodal Learning for Cognitive Impairment Detection
papers.authors: Sankalp Vaish, Rishank Singh, Sumukh Veeramalla, Caroline Summerour, John A. Batsis, Xiaohui Liang
papers.evidence: 利用语音交互中的视频、音频和文本进行多模态认知筛查
papers.tldr: 认知障碍的早期筛查在临床外仍较困难，仅依赖文本或语音难以全面刻画认知状态。研究利用参与者与Alexa完成三类结构化对话时采集的视频、音频和文本，比较任务差异、单模态表现与多模态融合效果。融合模型在指令朗读和问答任务上的准确率均为0.76，优于所报告的单模态结果。结果支持利用自然交互中的互补行为线索区分轻度认知障碍与健康老龄化，为非接触式认知筛查提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Dementia affects millions of older adults worldwide, yet early detection remains difficult outside clinical settings. Traditional models primarily rely on text or voice-based responses, capturing only a limited view of human cognition despite the inherently multimodal nature of human expression. This work proposes a contactless, multimodal screening framework that leverages video, audio, and text signals collected during structured voice-based interactions with Amazon Alexa. By incorporating these modalities, our approach captures a more holistic representation of human behavior encompassing speech patterns, vocal characteristics, facial expressions, and linguistic structure, which may enable more accurate detection of cognitive decline. Different participants completed three conversational tasks designed to probe spontaneous speech, comprehension, and recall. We pursued three objectives: (1) evaluate which of the three Alexa tasks provides the most informative cognitive signals, (2) compare the effectiveness of unimodal models, and (3) assess the benefits of multimodal fusion models. Task-level analysis shows that the video model achieves its best performance on Command-Reading, with an accuracy of 0.65 (AUC 0.69), while the audio model performs best on Question-Answering, reaching an accuracy of 0.67 (AUC 0.73). In contrast, the multimodal model demonstrates consistently stable performance across tasks, achieving an accuracy of 0.76 (AUC 0.75) on Command-Reading and 0.76 (AUC 0.73) on Question-Answering. These findings demonstrate that multimodal behavioral cues captured through naturalistic interactions can reliably distinguish MCI from healthy aging, highlighting the limitations of traditional diagnostic paradigms and supporting the shift toward multimodal, real-world cognitive assessment frameworks.

papers.title_en: Edit Discovery in Human-AI Interactions
papers.authors: Alireza Mirrokni, Shayan Kiyani, George Pappas, Hamed Hassani
papers.evidence: 筛选人机交互响应进行审核和修订，以形成监督信号
papers.tldr: 人机交互中蕴含可用于改进模型的错误案例，但调用专家或更强模型检查回答成本高，且事前无法确定是否需要修改。论文提出编辑发现优化，将漏掉修改机会、无效确认与编辑预算纳入统一框架，并设计仅利用已选交互反馈的在线算法EDIT。该算法逐轮满足预算约束，无需交互流的分布假设即可控制平均确认率，在四个推理与事实问答基准上取得更好的成本与两类错误权衡。其贡献是为有限审查资源下筛选高价值纠错数据提供理论与算法支撑。
papers.abstract_en: Human-AI interactions are becoming a rich source of data for improving AI systems: while many model responses are already satisfactory, others expose failures that could become valuable supervision if identified and corrected. We study this setting through the notion of an editor: a more capable evaluation process that can inspect a response and either confirm it or modify it, but whose invocation is costly. The editor may be a human expert, a stronger AI system, or the same model equipped with additional computation, context, tools, or information. The key challenge is to decide which interactions to send to the editor before knowing whether an edit will actually be made, since invoking the editor itself consumes limited resources such as expert time, inference cost, latency, or tool-use overhead. We formulate this problem as Edit Discovery Optimization (EDO), which seeks to minimize edit opportunities missed among skipped interactions while controlling unnecessary confirmations and respecting an editor-cost budget. We characterize the population-optimal policy and show that it takes the form of a cost-adjusted threshold on the posterior probability of an edit. Building on this structure, we develop EDIT (Edit Discovery via Iterative Thresholding), an online algorithm for the partial-feedback setting in which edit labels are revealed only for selected interactions. EDIT combines an adaptive edit score, a confirmation-control threshold, and a cost-aware selection rule; it satisfies the editor budget at every round and controls the average confirmation rate up to a vanishing finite-horizon term, without distributional assumptions on the interaction stream. Across four reasoning and factual question-answering benchmarks, EDIT achieves a better trade-off between editor cost, Type-I error, and Type-II error than direct LLM-based batch selection.

papers.title_en: ProPerAgent: Toward Memory-Driven Proactive Assistance
papers.authors: Shenglai Zeng, Xiao Yang, Tiffany Ma, Xinyuan Zhang, Nanshu Wang, Deren Lei, Kai Sun, Xilun Chen, Tammy Stark, Xianhui Zhu, Yuetai Li, Rulin Shao, Tianxin Wei, Rakesh Wanga, Anuj Kumar, Jiliang Tang, Wen-tau Yih, Xin Luna Dong
papers.evidence: 评测基于长期个人记忆触发主动助手干预的能力
papers.tldr: 主动助手不仅要回答正确，还须从长期个人记忆中判断是否及何时开口。论文提出基准ProPerMem，将第一视角视频与平均约61.8万词元的全年记忆配对，联合评估内容和时机。ProPerAgent通过图组织记忆、干预价值筛选及轻量强化学习，改善证据检索与触发控制，严格准确率最高达42.4%，而受测基线最高仅15%。结果表明，记忆检索与时机决策是主动协助不可缺少的双重能力。
papers.abstract_en: As assistants move from reactive answering toward proactive intervention, memory changes role: it no longer only supplies the answer to a query, it determines whether and when to speak at all. Prior work in this setting hands the system the relevant fact in context; we study the regime that makes the problem hard, where the evidence justifying an intervention must be mined from a long-horizon personal memory. We introduce ProPerMem, a benchmark for memory-driven proactive assistance (MPA), pairing egocentric video with year-long, distractor-rich user memories (~618K tokens on average), human-verified trigger windows, and a protocol that scores content and timing jointly. Every baseline we evaluate performs poorly (at most 15%), including frontier models given summarized or retrieval-augmented memory. A controlled study explains why: with oracle evidence delivered inside the trigger window GPT-5.3-Chat reaches 96%; letting it choose the timing drops it to 38%, and replacing oracle evidence with retrieval drops it to 15%. Content and timing are separately necessary, and missing either is catastrophic. Guided by this, we build ProPerAgent (Proactive Personalized Agent) with a plug-and-play harness that surfaces memory from a graph-organized store and gates it down to what is worth interrupting for, plus a lightweight RL stage that curbs early and repeated firing. Without any training, ProPerAgent lifts strict accuracy from below 10% to 37.5% on Qwen3.8-27B and 38% on GPT-5.3-Chat; RL post-training reaches 42.4%.

papers.title_en: ElectroCalm: Investigating User Experience and Physiological Responses to Multi-Node Transcutaneous Electrical Stimulation for Stress Modulation
papers.authors: Yoon Kyung Shon, Pablo E. Paredes
papers.evidence: 研究评估电触觉刺激作为触觉反馈时的用户体验。
papers.tldr: 经皮电刺激用于压力调节时，颈部敏感区域的使用体验，以及电触觉本身能否缓解压力，仍缺乏研究。研究在高认知负荷的二回溯任务中，用八节点电刺激阵列比较颈部与手臂，并设置电极贴附相同但不通电的对照。两处舒适度相近，均未干扰任务表现，但相同刺激引发不同感受；仅颈部刺激产生与压力调节一致的皮层及自主神经变化。结果提示，刺激位置同时影响体验与生理效果，不能将普通电触觉直接视为有效减压干预。
papers.abstract_en: Transcutaneous Electrical Stimulation (TES) for stress modulation has largely focused on vagus nerve stimulation at the neck, yet two questions remain underexplored: how users experience electrotactile sensations at this sensitive site, and whether electrotactile feedback itself can function as a haptic stress intervention. To investigate this gap, we applied an 8-node TES array to two body sites during a cognitively demanding 2-back task: the neck, a site used in prior vagal TES research for its anatomical proximity to the cervical vagus nerve, and the arm, the most common haptic wearable site, which primarily provides cutaneous electrotactile sensation without vagal access. In a usability study, both sites were rated as comparably comfortable without disrupting task performance, though the same stimulation was interpreted differently across sites. A second study assessing the physiological effects of active versus inactive stimulation under identical electrode attachment revealed that only neck TES produced cortical and autonomic changes consistent with stress modulation, while arm TES did not differ from inactive conditions. These findings suggest that neck TES can be acceptable despite the site's sensitivity, and that both the physiological effects and the sensory experience of TES depend on placement.

papers.title_en: Designing Human-AI Collaborative Science: The 9A Framework
papers.authors: Zihan Zheng, Linyue Pan, Xin Lan
papers.evidence: 框架整合协作科学中的任务分配、人机协调、决策权与系统评估
papers.tldr: 科学人工智能常被描述为从人类指导走向自主科研，但这一视角不足以解释人机共同塑造科学推理与研究方向的协作模式。论文提出9A框架，将协作系统设计分为组织、协调和评估三层，关联活动分工、决策权、信息共享、迭代推进及效果验证。框架的核心产出是统一这些设计维度，而非报告性能提升或实验验证。其意义在于把人机协作科研视为系统设计问题，为工作流构建及不同协作安排的实证比较提供基础。
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) for Science is often described as a progression from human-directed assistance toward increasingly autonomous AI scientists. Human-AI collaboration offers a further mode in which human and AI contributions substantively shape scientific reasoning, judgments, and the course of inquiry. Existing research addresses work allocation, human-AI coordination, and system evaluation, but how these aspects interact to shape collaborative scientific systems remains insufficiently articulated. We develop the 9A Framework for Human-AI Collaborative Science (HACS) to connect these considerations across three layers. The organization layer specifies what scientific activities are required (Activity), who performs them (Actor), and who holds authority over consequential decisions (Authority). The coordination layer addresses how participants access relevant research information (Awareness), how scientific work advances through iterative proposal, execution, examination, revision, and resolution (Accountability), and when collaborative arrangements should be adjusted (Adaptability). The evaluation layer establishes what constitutes effective system performance (Achievement), how comparisons can be designed to identify the effects of organizational and coordination choices (Attribution), and what evidence supports the resulting conclusions (Assurance). Together, these layers frame HACS as a system-design problem, providing a basis for designing collaborative scientific workflows and for empirically comparing their effectiveness.

papers.title_en: Validating LLM-generated political networks with survey-reported partisan exposure
papers.authors: Marco Tonin, Michele Tizzoni, Bruno Lepri, Luca Maria Aiello
papers.evidence: 用受访者报告的党派信息接触验证大模型生成的政治网络。
papers.tldr: 大语言模型生成的社交网络即使整体结构合理，也未必准确还原个人的政治接触环境。研究以美国全国代表性调查中的受访者构建人物画像，生成政治网络，并将个体党派接触与自报数据对照。结果发现，部分模型夸大两党隔离，另一些则普遍低估共和党接触；政治同配性相近的网络，也可能产生不同的局部环境，并对特定群体出现方向不同的偏差。这说明社会模拟不能仅凭宏观网络指标验收，还需结合个体与群体层面的经验验证。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human behavior in social science research, including decisions, interactions, and social relationships. However, in network formation tasks, existing evaluations often focus on aggregate network properties, while networks with plausible structural properties may still fail to reproduce individuals' social and political environments. Here, we generate LLM-based political networks using personas sampled from the nationally representative ANES 2020--2022 Social Media Study and use respondents' survey-reported partisan exposure as an empirical benchmark for the political environments generated for the corresponding personas. We first characterize the structural properties and political assortativity of the generated networks, and then compare ego-level partisan exposure with the survey. We find that the structure and political assortativity of the generated networks vary across experimental configurations. More importantly, when comparing generated partisan exposure with the survey, some models generate stronger separation between Democratic and Republican egos than reported in the survey, with higher same-party and lower cross-party exposure, while others mainly underestimate Republican exposure across ego groups. Moreover, networks with similar political assortativity can still generate different partisan environments around the same personas, including among networks with plausible structural properties. Finally, generated networks show group-specific errors, under- or overestimating exposure to either Democrats or Republicans for specific social groups. These findings show that evaluating LLM-based social simulations only through aggregate outcomes can hide errors in the local environments through which those outcomes emerge, highlighting the importance of validation at both aggregate and individual levels.

papers.title_en: MobileJailBench: Red Queen Jailbreak Benchmarking for Mobile Agents
papers.authors: Songping Wang, Borui Li, Qinglong Liu, Yueming Lyu, Yi Huang, Fengting Li, Chao Feng, Caifeng Shan
papers.evidence: 通过动态越狱测试评估自主移动智能体的隐私与安全风险
papers.tldr: 移动智能体的自主感知与操作扩大了攻击面，但现有越狱评测偏重对话、任务静态且指标单一。MobileJailBench在高保真移动沙箱中构建520项任务，覆盖三类越狱范式和14类风险，并结合双动态演化与分层裁决。实验发现，智能体尤其易受隐式越狱影响，动态演化攻击在Qwen3.5-122B上达到100%攻击成功率。该基准以持续扩展的真实工作流评测，追踪从安全认知、执行行为到风险后果的安全边界。
papers.abstract_en: MLLM-based mobile agents are rapidly gaining autonomy in perception, planning, and closed-loop execution in dynamic mobile environments. However, this autonomy also broadens the attack surface and amplifies the risks of malicious misuse, including privacy leakage, device compromise, and large-scale phishing. Existing jailbreak evaluations leave three critical gaps for mobile agents: they focus on conversational attacks instead of mobile workflows, use static task sets with fixed difficulty, and rely narrowly on attack success rate rather than comprehensive security assessment. To close these gaps, we present MobileJailBench, the first evolving jailbreak benchmark for mobile agents, comprising three key components: (1) a benchmark comprising 520 tasks spanning three jailbreak paradigms and 14 risk categories, built on a high-fidelity mobile sandbox that we construct, enabling realistic workflows across over 20 widely used apps; (2) Dual-Dynamic Evolution, which combines Failure-Distilled Jailbreak Evolution with Weakness-Driven Benchmark Expansion; and (3) Stratified Adjudication Framework for assessing security awareness, execution behavior, and risk consequences. Extensive experiments show that current mobile agents are particularly vulnerable to implicit jailbreaks, as their safety alignment remains largely superficial and fails to generalize from conversational refusal to dynamic mobile interactions. Moreover, our dynamic evolution mechanism sharpens practical threat boundaries by continually uncovering new vulnerabilities, reaching a 100% ASR on Qwen3.5-122B. MobileJailBench provides a reproducible, continuously evolving framework for tracking the true security boundaries of mobile agents.

papers.title_en: Wait for It: A Component-Level Analysis of Latency Feedback Mechanisms for LLM Agents in VR
papers.authors: Pratham Arora, Abhinav Lodha, Siddharth Siddharth
papers.evidence: 用户研究比较虚拟现实智能体的延迟反馈设计
papers.tldr: 大语言模型驱动的虚拟现实智能体存在响应延迟，等待反馈如何影响沉浸感与社交体验尚不清楚。研究通过18名参与者的被试内实验，分别比较语气填充词、加载图标和思考动作三类反馈。结果显示，具身动作在多个维度显著优于加载图标，使智能体更鲜活、更具社会临场感；加载图标反而削弱类人感并破坏沉浸。研究据此提出设计建议：优先用自然行为承接等待，避免技术提示将用户从社交互动拉回系统操作。
papers.abstract_en: Delays in AI responses pose a significant challenge to immersive Virtual Reality experiences. While previous research demonstrates that feedback can reduce the perception of waiting, we lack understanding of which types work best and why. We conducted a within-subjects study with 18 participants to systematically compare three isolated feedback approaches during VR agent interactions: verbal fillers (e.g., um..., hmm...), visual indicators (loading spinners), and embodied gestures (thinking animations). Our results revealed that embodied gestures significantly outperformed visual loading indicators across multiple dimensions, making agents feel more lifelike and socially present. Interestingly, explicit visual feedback like loading spinners actually degraded perceived humanness and broke immersion by forcing users to shift from social to technical mental models. These findings suggest that natural, behavior-based feedback maintains the illusion of conversing with a thinking entity, while technical indicators expose the computational substrate. We present empirically-grounded design guidelines for creating more engaging AI-powered VR agents.

papers.title_en: MARS: Memory-Aware Routing for Session-Level LLM Assistants
papers.authors: Minghan Wang, Jinhang Zuo, Zhongxiang Dai, Zhiyong Wang, Fang Kong
papers.evidence: 协调长期助手的记忆构建与会话中的模型选择
papers.tldr: 长期LLM助手需同时决定调用哪些历史记忆、由哪个模型回答，分开决策容易忽视记忆对输入难度的影响。MARS以会话状态连接记忆构建与模型路由，为每轮交互配置记忆视图和回答模型。在RealMem上，其问答表现达到全上下文GPT-4o的98.2%，计入控制器调用后的API成本仅为基线生成成本的14.5%。该方法展示了长历史交互中的质量—记忆—成本优势，但在MultiChallenge上仍落后于最强静态系统。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term LLM assistants must repeatedly decide what prior context to expose and which model should answer as an interaction evolves. Existing memory systems and model routers usually make these decisions separately, although memory construction changes the evidence, distractors, and difficulty of the resulting input. We introduce MARS, a memory-aware routing framework that uses session state as a shared control interface between memory construction and model selection. A Query and Topic Manager (QTM) estimates compact decision-relevant state that guides a fixed state-conditioned memory policy and an online router, enabling each turn to receive an appropriate memory view and a suitable model under a quality-memory-cost trade-off. We evaluate MARS on RealMem and MultiChallenge with 16 system configurations each, covering long-history memory-driven interaction and bounded sessions with structured context interference. On RealMem, MARS preserves 98.2% of full-context GPT-4o's QA while using only 14.5% of its generation API cost, including both generation and controller calls for MARS, and achieves the strongest measured memory-recall and retrieval scores among compared systems. On MultiChallenge, MARS trails the strongest static system overall but approaches its performance at lower recorded cost on a mechanism-focused subset. Together, these results support a favorable quality-memory-cost trade-off for long-history, memory-dependent interaction.

papers.title_en: SIT-Eval: Situation-Based Interactive Turn-by-Turn Evaluation of Conversational Agents
papers.authors: Ravil Mussabayev, Saveliy Zavertyaev, Dmitriy Parpulov, Andrey Savchenko
papers.evidence: 评估对话智能体在多种互动情境中的表现。
papers.tldr: 静态对话基准难以覆盖罕见情境，总体得分也可能掩盖具体行为缺陷。SIT-Eval将期望行为定义为条件式情境规则，每轮由对话模型触发均匀采样的情境，再由结合上下文的裁判依据所有适用规则评估回复，并用人工核验的合成对话验证裁判。对8个模型、1292轮对话的测试表明，总分相近的模型在单项规则遵循上差异显著，且普遍不擅长歧义澄清和苏格拉底式提问。该框架为定位情境相关失效提供了细粒度评测方法。
papers.abstract_en: The rapid proliferation of conversational AI agents necessitates evaluation methods that assess performance across diverse dialogue scenarios, utilizing multiple situational criteria, as appropriate behavior depends on context and encompasses various aspects. Existing dialogue benchmarks typically use static natural conversations, which underrepresent rare situations---a critical safety gap, as low-probability events become frequent failures at production scale. However, limited sample sizes force a choice: either maintain natural dialogues for realism or turn to adaptive situation sampling for comprehensive yet statistically reliable coverage. We introduce SIT-Eval, an adjustable framework for evaluating situation-based conversational agents. We formalize an agent's desired behavior as situational rules: if situation is P, follow rules Q. At each conversation turn, an LLM-interlocutor enacts a uniformly sampled situation. A context-aware LLM-judge leverages all conditionally applicable rules as criteria to evaluate the agent's reply for that situation. The judge is validated using human-verified synthetic golden dialogues. Benchmarking 8 LLMs on 1292 conversation turns reveals failure modes hidden by aggregate metrics: models with similar overall scores vary widely in their adherence to individual rules. All models struggle most with ambiguity clarification and Socratic questioning.

papers.title_en: Beyond Corrected Actions: Training LLM Agents on Textual Critiques
papers.authors: Thomas Zeng, Zelei Cheng, Mingyang Zhou, Sambit Sahu, William Campbell, Genta Indra Winata
papers.evidence: 使用专家生成的文字批评作为智能体训练反馈。
papers.tldr: 多轮交互智能体容易出现策略违规、工具调用错误或信息收集不足，但传统专家蒸馏主要教授正确动作，缺少对学生错误原因的解释。论文提出批评增强智能体微调框架CAFT，在学生生成的轨迹上，为错误动作同时提供专家纠正和文字批评，并用于微调。在两个模型家族的四个学生模型及航空、零售和网页购物任务上，该方法较仅动作监督平均提升8%，还可为强化学习提供更好的初始化。结果表明，解释为何出错能增强智能体训练监督。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for multi-turn agentic tasks that require interactions with users and environments over extended sequences of actions. A common approach to improving LLM agents is to use more capable expert models to provide training supervision, either by behavior cloning the expert's trajectories or by using the expert to correct the actions in trajectories generated by the weaker student model. However, expert LLMs can provide richer supervision than actions alone: they can directly generate textual critique that explain why specific actions are incorrect. We study whether training on such feedback benefits LLM agents and propose Critique-Augmented Agentic Fine-Tuning (CAFT), a framework that elicits textual expert feedback on student-generated trajectories. For each incorrect action, the expert yields both a corrected action and a textual critique explaining the student's mistake--which we then use as the training target for fine-tuning. Across four student models from the Nemotron 3 and Gemma 4 families on the agentic domains $τ^2$-Bench Airline+Retail and WebShop, adding critiques to action-level supervision improves performance by 8% on average over action-only distillation. Additionally, CAFT checkpoints can also provide a better warm start for reinforcement learning than expert-trajectory distillation. Our results demonstrate that textual critiques can strengthen supervision for multi-turn LLM agents.

papers.title_en: ReviewPilot: A Multi-Agent System for Screening and Data Extraction in Systematic Reviews
papers.authors: Zhaoqian Xue, Shaoze Zhou, Xuexin Li, Junting Mu, Haozheng Liu, Zhongyin Wang, Yichun He, Renkai Ma, Hao Zhou, Sarah Bratt, Siyuan Ma, Chen Chen, Lingyao Li
papers.evidence: 研究者可对话设定筛选标准，系统记录决策理由与证据来源
papers.tldr: 系统综述需要记录文献排除理由与证据来源，但现有大模型研究工具往往只提供搜索和总结。ReviewPilot以对话式多智能体系统衔接文献筛选与数据提取，支持研究者调整标准和字段，并通过项目记忆保存配置与修订。在流行病学专家综述评测中，筛选宏平均F1最高达0.776，提取F1最高达0.788，优于单提示大模型和AgentSLR。生物医学与人机交互案例还显示其具有跨领域应用潜力，为可追溯的系统综述自动化提供支持。
papers.abstract_en: Systematic literature reviews follow the PRISMA process of screening scholarly works and extracting evidence from included studies. Deep research tools based on large language models (LLMs) can search and summarize the literature but do not record which studies are excluded or where extracted values come from. We develop a conversational multi-agent system called ReviewPilot that automates the PRISMA workflow from paper screening to information extraction. Researchers can tailor criteria and schemas through dialogue, and a project memory keeps their configurations and revisions. Each screening decision comes with its reason and each extracted value with its source. On epidemiological expert reviews, ReviewPilot outperforms a single-prompt LLM and AgentSLR across three LLMs, with screening macro F1 up to 0.776 and extraction F1 up to 0.788. Case studies in biomedicine and human-computer interaction show close agreement with human annotators, suggesting that ReviewPilot can transfer beyond epidemiology. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhaoqianXue/ReviewPilot.

papers.title_en: Beyond Latent Personalization: Integrating HRV-Conditioned Personalization via LLM for Interpretable Stress Detection
papers.authors: Wei-Hsiang Ma, Ya-Tse Wu, Hsing-Hang Chou, Chi-Chun Lee
papers.evidence: 利用个体生理信号进行可解释的压力检测与监测
papers.tldr: 基于心率变异性的压力检测需要考虑个体差异，但现有个性化方法主要通过潜在表示融合个人属性与生理特征，难以解释两者的交互。本文引入大语言模型，对心率变异性特征与个人属性进行语义解释，辅助个性化压力检测。在TILES-2018数据集上，该框架较最强基线的MCC相对提升29.9%，并提供可读的个体生理反应描述。研究表明，语义解释有望兼顾个性化检测性能与可解释性。
papers.abstract_en: Stress detection based on heart rate variability (HRV) has received increasing attention. However, existing personalized approaches integrate personal attributes with HRV through latent representations, limiting the interpretability of their interactions. In this work, we propose an LLM-enhanced personalized stress detection framework that integrates HRV features and personal attributes through LLM-based semantic interpretation. The proposed framework achieves a 29.9% relative MCC improvement over the strongest baseline on TILES-2018 while providing human-readable descriptions of individual physiological responses. The results highlight the potential of LLM-based semantic interpretation for achieving both effective and interpretable personalized stress detection.

papers.title_en: Towards Adaptive and Real-Survey-Aligned Simulated Urban Mobility Behaviour of Generative Agents
papers.authors: Yves Bru, Kamaldeep Singh Oberoi, Benoit Gaudou
papers.evidence: 生成式智能体基于真实调查模拟人的出行选择
papers.tldr: 传统城市出行仿真的行为空间受预设变量和规则限制，难以应对未见情境，而生成式智能体能否贴近真实出行仍待验证。研究基于法国图卢兹家庭出行调查，构建多模式日常出行仿真，比较十五种决策器。调优提示的生成式智能体在无交通扰动时，出行方式总体占比接近拟合模型，但逐次出行表现仍有差距；它们也会响应突发事件。类型化分类器同样表现突出，提示行为仿真不必依赖文本生成，也不能仅凭总体分布吻合判断真实性。
papers.abstract_en: In existing agent-based simulations of multimodal urban mobility, agents, representing humans, choose their travel modes either using discrete choice or machine learning models fitted on structured travel survey data, or with rules explicitly written by the domain experts. Such approaches fix a priori the agents' possible behaviour space. Hence, a factor absent from variables or rules cannot affect agents' decisions. In reality, choosing a transport mode is a multidimensional decision in which objective and subjective factors intertwine and change over time. Integrating such complexity into a city-scale multimodal mobility simulation remains a challenge. Generative agents (GAs) built on large language models promise to respond to this challenge because they carry decision heuristics that travel surveys do not record. However, to the best of our knowledge, aligning their decisions with real household travel surveys remains an open question. In this paper, we build an agent-based model of daily multimodal mobility for Toulouse (France). We compare the performance of fifteen decision-makers (simple baselines, models fitted on the survey, GAs with minimal and tuned prompts, and a typed classifier) on the real household travel survey. Our results show that GAs with tuned prompts come close to the fitted models on the modal split of a simulated day without transport disruptions, but not trip by trip. GAs also react when unforeseen events occur. The recently released Jev-1.13 TypeSafe classifier gives surprisingly great results, showing that generating output text is not necessary. The results presented in this paper would be of interest to transport policy makers and service providers looking to apply generative agent-based modelling for improving urban mobility services.

papers.title_en: Learning User Representations to Improve Simulation Fidelity
papers.authors: Shuhaib Mehri, Philippe Laban, Michel Galley, Dilek Tür, Jennifer Neville, Jianfeng Gao
papers.evidence: 优化用户表征，使模拟器更准确复现个体对话行为。
papers.tldr: 现有用户模拟器难以复现真实用户的多样行为，限制了助手对代表性不足用户的泛化。论文将自然语言用户表征视为关键瓶颈，通过重建原始对话、比较模拟行为获取事后反馈，再将改进蒸馏进表征生成器。在七个数据集的700段对话上，UserRepGen-4B生成的表征比GPT-5.5生成的表征支持更保真的模拟。该方法还改善了未见任务上的模拟、群体多样性保留与跨对话用户区分，表明学习用户表征是提升模拟质量的有效路径。
papers.abstract_en: User simulators enable interactive training and evaluation of AI assistants at scale. Yet current simulators struggle to reproduce the diverse behaviors of real users, leading to assistants that generalize poorly to underrepresented users. We identify user representations as an underexplored bottleneck in user simulation. User representations are natural-language descriptions that condition simulators to reproduce a particular user's behavior. A representation's quality becomes apparent in hindsight, through the behavior it induces in a simulator. To evaluate and optimize user representations, we formulate a conversation reconstruction task: given an original conversation, we generate a representation, condition a simulator on it, simulate a conversation, and then measure fidelity by comparing user behavior in the original and simulated conversations. This comparison also yields hindsight feedback, which identifies where the representation falls short and how it can be improved. We introduce hindsight distillation, an online training procedure that distills feedback-conditioned improvements into the representation generator, enabling it to generate improved representations directly from the original conversation. We present UserRepGen-4B, a representation generator trained with hindsight distillation. Across 700 conversations spanning seven datasets, hindsight feedback helps improve user representations at test time, and UserRepGen-4B generates representations that enable more faithful simulation than those generated by GPT-5.5. Beyond conversation reconstruction, learned representations improve simulation fidelity for unseen tasks, better preserve the population-level diversity of real users, and better distinguish users across conversations.

papers.title_en: Gossip Agents: Reputation through Opinion Dynamics over Evolving Networks
papers.authors: Yutong Wu, Arlei Silva
papers.evidence: 研究多智能体中的声誉传播与合作
papers.tldr: 多智能体合作依赖声誉，但现有方法常假设声誉全局可见或仅来自亲身观察，忽略信息如何传播。本文让智能体根据有限观察形成私人评价，再按DeGroot意见动力学与动态网络中的邻居交换第三方信息，并以广播半径调节传播范围。在随机重组群体的多人囚徒困境和移动形成邻域的资源采集环境中，声誉传播范围均影响合作；后者还呈现更高环境奖励、更和平且可持续的行为。研究将局部闲谈纳入声誉机制，为设计合作型多智能体系统提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Sustained cooperation among self-interested learning agents is essential in many shared environments. Reputation systems are among the best-studied mechanisms for promoting such cooperation. Existing multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches, however, typically assume that reputation is either globally available to all agents or derived solely from an agent's own observations, leaving largely unexplored how reputational information propagates between agents. We study gossip, the exchange of information about third parties, as a mechanism for reputation diffusion over dynamic communication networks. Agents form private opinions from limited observations and exchange them with their neighbors following DeGroot opinion dynamics, while the communication network changes as agents interact and move. A tunable broadcast radius controls the reach of information, spanning private reputation, local gossip, and globally shared reputation. We study this framework in two \(n\)-player social dilemmas with distinct network dynamics: a Prisoner's Dilemma with randomly resampled interaction groups and Harvest, where communication neighborhoods emerge from agents' movements. Our results show that the reach of reputational information shapes cooperation in both environments. Moreover, in Harvest, reputation diffusion increases environmental rewards and leads to more peaceful and sustainable behavior.

papers.title_en: From Approval to Abuse: Privilege Escalation Attacks on Harness-Protected Coding Agents
papers.authors: Xianglin Yang, Yechao Zhang, Jiahao Liu, Yulin Chen, Yuxin Cao, Bryan Hooi, Jiaheng Zhang
papers.evidence: 揭示不可信上下文可操纵用户授权规则并扩大编码智能体权限。
papers.tldr: 编程智能体依赖执行防护层拦截越权操作，但可复用的授权规则也会扩大后续权限。论文通过在代码仓库植入恶意上下文，诱导智能体为常规任务申请看似合理、实则过宽的规则。在 Claude Code、Codex CLI 等平台，目标规则请求成功率为58%；获批规则覆盖56.9%的分类能力测试用例，获批后的静默攻击成功率为81.0%。研究揭示，攻击者可将一次人工授权转化为持续越权，削弱人在回路的安全保障。
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents use execution harnesses to constrain the consequences of prompt injection by enforcing permission boundaries. These systems deterministically intercept any out-of-sandbox action and prompt the user for approval. To reduce approval fatigue, users can approve allow-rules proposed by the agent, after which any future action matching the rule is allowed without a prompt. In this work, we show that this mechanism introduces a new risk: untrusted context can influence the permissions presented for approval, with consequences extending beyond the immediate task. We investigate privilege escalation targeting this permission-update process. Specifically, adversarial context planted in a repository can reliably steer an agent performing a routine task into requesting a plausibly justified, yet dangerously broad allow-rule. If the user approves the request, the saved rule can effectively blind the harness, enabling adversaries to execute malicious actions that would otherwise require approval, without triggering human oversight. Across production platforms, including Claude Code and Codex CLI, we demonstrate that agents successfully elicit the target allow-rules in 58% of experimental instances. Once acquired, these rules exhibit a massive semantic blast radius, covering 56.9% of category-specific capability test cases. To further quantify the downstream risk, we show that conditional on rule approval, our exploit achieves verified, silent goal completion in 47 of the 58 eligible instances (81.0%), undermining the safety promise of human-in-the-loop oversight.

papers.title_en: Adaptation of Computer Use Agents to New Software with User Manuals
papers.authors: Chulhoon Yoon, Kyungri Park, Jinyeong Yun, Daeyun Jeong, Sukmin Yun, Woohwan Jung
papers.evidence: 操作软件图形界面的智能体与计算机使用代理相关
papers.tldr: 计算机操作智能体在陌生软件上常因缺乏长流程操作知识而失效，适配训练又依赖昂贵的人工任务与演示。MAGE利用用户手册检索相关内容并生成操作计划，同时将手册转化为任务—计划对，引导环境交互、收集轨迹并优化策略，以应对手册与实际界面的差异。在六款应用上的实验显示，该框架相较强基线提升了任务成功率。其贡献是将手册统一用于执行指导和适配训练，降低对人工编写训练数据的依赖。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have significantly improved the ability to operate real-world software through graphical user interfaces (GUIs) using visual observations and natural language instructions. However, maintaining strong performance on unseen applications remains challenging, as practical tasks often require long-horizon procedural knowledge and application-specific operation patterns. In addition, constructing executable tasks and collecting corresponding trajectories for training still heavily rely on human-annotated data, incurring substantial cost. In this paper, we propose MAGE (Manual-augmented computer use AGent Execution and learning), a framework that leverages user manuals as a scalable source of procedural knowledge to improve both inference and training. During execution, MAGE retrieves task-relevant manual content and uses a planner to generate explicit procedural guidance for CUAs. To further account for the discrepancies between manuals and actual GUI environments, such as version differences or user settings, MAGE also adapts the agent policy through environment interaction. During training, MAGE converts manuals into executable task-plan pairs and uses the plans to guide environment rollouts toward task-relevant states; the resulting trajectories are then used to optimize the policy without human-authored demonstrations. This unified design enables effective utilization of manuals for both task execution and training, reducing reliance on human-authored training data. Experimental results across six applications demonstrate improvements in task success rates over strong baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of manual-guided planning and policy adaptation in new software environments. We provide the code and reproduction scripts at https://github.com/ku-autoai/MAGE.

papers.title_en: Beyond Reward Scoring: Online Multi-Agent Preference Learning for Multimodal Response Generation
papers.authors: Ziyun Zou, Jiwoo Hong, Yifan Lu, Shao Tang, Weiyi Wu, Aman Gupta, Jin Tian, Imran Razzak
papers.evidence: 通过在线强化学习使模型理解人类偏好的理由
papers.tldr: 多模态偏好对齐通常将人类偏好压缩为奖励分数，生成模型缺少对偏好原因的显式学习。PrefMind采用在线双智能体强化学习，让生成器与偏好评判器共同讨论候选回答，并依据人类标签学习判断与纠错。双方正确识别偏好后，生成器改进回答，评判器通过比较提供生成奖励，两者联合更新。三个模型规模的实验均显示，独立偏好判断与下游回答生成得到提升，支持将偏好理解内化为生成模型能力的路线。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal preference alignment often follows a score-based RLHF pipeline: a reward model is first trained to learn human preferences, then used to score on-policy responses and optimize the response model's generation. This turns preference supervision into a scalar signal for generation: a model may learn to produce answers with higher preference scores, but is rarely trained explicitly to learn the reasons underlying human preferences. We therefore ask whether making preference understanding an internal capability of the response model can improve its generation. To investigate this question, we propose \textbf{PrefMind}, an online dual-agent reinforcement learning framework with two trainable agents: a response Generator and a preference Critic. Given a pair of candidate responses, the agents analyze and discuss which response better aligns with human preference. Human labels supervise their judgments and corrections. For pairs on which both the Generator and revised Critic correctly identify the human-preferred response, the Generator produces an improved answer, and the Critic compares it against the original preferred response to provide a generation reward. Both agents are jointly updated from interactions sampled with their current policies. Through this process, \textbf{PrefMind} trains the Generator to understand human preferences via explicit judgment and correction, and to translate this understanding into better responses. Experiments across three model scales show improvements in both standalone preference judgment and downstream response generation.

papers.title_en: Designing for Imperfect Prompts: A Simulation-Based Evaluation of an LLM-Based Enterprise Data Assistant Using Knowledge Graphs
papers.authors: Niklas Wagner, Alexander Mädche
papers.evidence: 设计并评估能够处理用户不完善提示词的大语言模型企业数据助手。
papers.tldr: 企业数据助手面对业务用户的领域术语、缺失表结构信息等不完善提示时，容易误解意图并检索错误数据。研究设计语义中介层，对比基于语义相似度的数据库模式匹配与基于数据湖自动构建知识图谱的方案。使用真实业务数据开展模拟评估，并结合大模型评审和人工验证，知识图谱方案在精确率、召回率、F1及意图保留方面均更优。研究据此提出设计原则，以结构化知识连接业务语言与数据库结构，降低不同技能用户的数据访问门槛。
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise data assistants using large language models (LLMs) promise democratized data access in organizations. Yet in our real-world deployment within the CFO unit's data lake at an industry partner, we observed that business users frequently pose imperfect prompts that include domain-specific vocabulary and lack schema references or structural information. This Design Science Research study examines automatic resolution using a semantic mediation layer. We design and evaluate two design variants: schema-based mediation via semantic similarity, and knowledge graph-based mediation leveraging an automatically constructed knowledge graph from the data lake. Our simulation-based evaluation using real-world data, supported by LLM-as-a-Judge assessments and human validation, shows that knowledge graph-based mediation outperforms the schema-based approach in Precision, Recall, F1, and preserving user intent. We propose a design principle for knowledge graph-based mediation, demonstrating that structured knowledge representation bridges user intent and database structure and guides the design of enterprise data assistants across skill levels.

papers.title_en: Reliable Memory from Unstable Growth: Curating Self-Written Agent Playbooks with Randomized Experiments
papers.authors: Hoang Pham, Cong-Duy Nguyen, Dong Le, Ponhvoan Srey, Anh Tuan Luu
papers.evidence: 为语言模型智能体跨任务筛选和维护持久记忆
papers.tldr: 智能体可用自写文本记忆复用经验，但自行判断哪些经验有用会导致表现不稳，最差比无记忆低69.6个百分点。论文提出随机分块筛选，将相关经验成组，在练习任务中随机加入或移除，以成功率差异估计各组效果。随后保留有益组，并在新练习回合中比较多个筛选版、完整记忆及无记忆方案。跨两种记忆系统、三种模型和三个基准，平均成功率达66.9%，高于完整记忆的55.5%，表明实测效果比智能体自评更适合指导记忆筛选。
papers.abstract_en: Persistent textual memory lets language-model agents reuse lessons from past tasks to improve on future multi-step tasks without retraining. Systems such as ACE and Dynamic Cheatsheet keep it as a playbook: lessons the agent writes after each task and reads in its prompt. A key challenge is to decide which lessons improve later tasks. Current systems leave the decision to the agent itself, which makes performance unstable: the same procedure can write a playbook that helps or one that falls up to 69.6 points below no playbook. These findings motivate valuing lessons by their measured effect on task success rather than by the agent's judgment. We propose Randomized Block Curation (RBC), which measures this effect with a randomized experiment on practice tasks. It groups related lessons into blocks large enough to move success measurably and, on each practice task, includes or leaves out every block at random. Random inclusion makes tasks with and without a block comparable, so the gap in their success estimates the block's effect. RBC keeps the blocks that help and, since the same procedure can write a helpful or a harmful playbook, grows several and serves whichever curated, whole or no playbook scores best on fresh practice episodes. Across two memory systems, three models and three benchmarks, RBC raises average success to 66.9, against 55.5 with the whole playbook, 54.1 with no playbook and 53.8 when the agent's own judgment picks the lessons to keep.

papers.title_en: GeoMER: A Joint Euclidean-Hyperbolic Geometry Framework for Multimodal Emotion Recognition
papers.authors: Ting Zhu, Huizhi Liang, Boguslaw Obara, Shufei Duan, Varun Ojha
papers.evidence: 通过多模态识别情绪状态
papers.tldr: 多模态情感识别通常依赖欧氏表示，虽能捕捉细粒度跨模态交互，却缺少组织情感潜在层级关系的几何先验。GeoMER联合欧氏与双曲空间，以欧氏融合模块建模词元级交互，再通过双曲情感核心路由聚合抽象情感特征。在IEMOCAP上，其加权准确率达83.54%，非加权准确率达83.35%，优于包括MemoCMT在内的欧氏基线。结果支持以互补几何表示增强情感识别。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) aims to understand human emotions by integrating information from multiple modalities such as speech and text. Psychological studies suggest that emotions exhibit latent hierarchical structured relationships in their semantic representations. However, most MER approaches rely on Euclidean representations, which capture fine-grained cross-modal interactions but do not explicitly provide a geometric prior for organizing hierarchical emotional structures. To mitigate this gap, we propose GeoMER, a joint Euclidean-Hyperbolic modeling framework that introduces hyperbolic emotion-core routing to capture higher-level, abstract emotional representations for MER. The proposed framework jointly models token-level cross-modal semantic interactions and latent emotion representations in two complementary geometric spaces. Specifically, GeoMER consists of a Euclidean Multimodal Fusion Module (EuclFusion) for multimodal representation fusion and a Hyperbolic Geometric Core Routing (HypGeoRoute) module that performs geometry-aware core assignment and aggregation in a hyperbolic manifold to capture more abstract feature representations. The HypGeoRoute module complements the Euclidean token-level modeling. We experiment on the IEMOCAP multimodal MER benchmark and demonstrate that the proposed method achieves the best performance, with 83.54% weighted accuracy and 83.35% unweighted accuracy, outperforming Euclidean baselines, including MemoCMT.

papers.title_en: Popularity-driven interactions in multilayer bounded-confidence opinion dynamics
papers.authors: Senne De Bruyn, Luis Enrique Correa Rocha
papers.evidence: 分析社交媒体流行度驱动的曝光如何影响意见多样性与聚类
papers.tldr: 社交媒体用户既与好友互动，也接触平台推荐内容，但注意力往往集中于少数热门用户。论文构建有界信任意见动力学模型，将社交网络与全连接探索层耦合，并让互动对象的选择受动态人气分数驱动。均匀探索促进跨圈层混合、减少意见多样性；人气集中则削弱这种同质化作用，使少数热门用户成为意见吸引子。研究揭示，平台外部接触并不必然促进共识，人气不平等可在原本达成共识的条件下维持极化，且效果依赖底层网络结构。
papers.abstract_en: Social media users interact with their own social networks but also with platform-wide content, where a small number of highly popular users may receive a disproportionate share of attention. In this paper, we study how those interactions outside the social networks and user popularity regulate the formation of opinion clusters. We design a bounded-confidence opinion dynamics model on a multilayer network consisting of a social network coupled to a fully connected explore layer of potential interaction contacts. We show that uniform sampling on the explore layer increases mixing across social neighbourhoods and reduces opinion diversity while also weakening the influence of the underlying social network. We then introduce a popularity-driven interaction mechanism in which contact selection is biased by a time-evolving popularity score, so that frequently selected users become increasingly likely to be re-selected. The resulting concentration of explore-layer interactions on a small number of highly popular users reduces the homogenising effect of the explore layer, increasing opinion diversity. The resulting changes relative to a single-layer system depend on the underlying social network structure. As the popularity inequality increases, a small number of highly popular users can act as opinion attractors and sustain polarisation in regimes where the corresponding model without popularity heterogeneity converges to consensus.

papers.title_en: NICE Toolbox: Nonverbal Interpersonal Communication Exploration Toolbox
papers.authors: Aleksandr Evgrashin, Carolin Schmitt, Timo Lübbing, Ashutosh Jha, Buket Naz Zeren, Sophie K. Bauer, Johannes Kopf-Beck, Anton K. G. Marx, Anamaria Semm, Gökce Ergün, Senya Polikovsky
papers.evidence: 整合视觉与语音方法测量姿态、手势、注视和面部表情等多模态信号
papers.tldr: 人际交流研究需要分析姿态、手势、视线、表情和语音，但人工标注耗时，分散的算法工具也难以整合。NICE工具箱以免费开源的Python框架，将现有计算机视觉与语音处理方法统一到同一软件包。它支持多摄像头、检测算法替换、二维与三维可视化、自有数据评估及第三方软件导出。其贡献在于降低心理学研究的技术门槛，提升多模态交流信号分析的规模化能力与可复现性；摘要未提供定量性能结果。
papers.abstract_en: Understanding human communication is a long-standing goal in psychological research. People express themselves through many verbal and nonverbal channels: posture, gesture, gaze, facial expression, and speech. Measurement and annotation of these signals has traditionally required time-consuming manual work by trained human labellers. The Nonverbal Interpersonal Communication Exploration (NICE) Toolbox is a free, open-source Python framework that automatically measures these signals by combining existing state-of-the-art computer vision and speech-processing methods into a single software package. It includes support for multi-camera systems, interchangeable detection algorithms, 2D and 3D visualization of detector outputs, evaluation on the user's custom data, and export to third-party software. With the release of this tool, we aim to make data exploration of interpersonal communication signals scalable, reproducible, and accessible for psychological research.

papers.title_en: Not All Graphs Are Maps: A Task-Agnostic Exploration Framework for Mobile GUI Navigation
papers.authors: Adamo Orsini, Seyed Mehdi Ayyoubzadeh, Sadman Rakib Pinon, Hannuo Zhang, Koosha Gholipour Baradari, Yuanhao Yu, Xinxin Zuo, Yang Wang
papers.evidence: 移动图形界面智能体借助持久记忆完成应用导航任务
papers.tldr: 移动GUI智能体虽能识别屏幕并执行局部操作，却缺少可复用的应用导航知识，每次任务都需重新寻找目标页面。TAG-Nav在接触评测指令前离线探索应用，将功能、目标页和途经路线压缩为记忆，供后续任务检索。自动BFS记忆使两种骨干模型的严格导航成功率分别提高5.9和11.9个百分点。论文同时提出仅评估到达操作前目标页的DestBench，揭示目的地覆盖与路线质量决定图记忆的实际价值。
papers.abstract_en: Modern mobile GUI agents can perceive visible screens and execute local actions, but they still lack persistent app-specific navigation knowledge: where functions live, which pages contain them, and which screens are equivalent across repeated visits. We introduce TAG-Nav, a Task-Agnostic Graph Navigation framework that wraps existing GUI-agent backbones with reusable destination memory. Offline exploration is distilled into compact records of app functions, target pages, and waypoint routes before any evaluated instruction is seen. When a future task's destination is covered, TAG-Nav retrieves the destination and provides route guidance without task-specific demonstrations. This separates mobile GUI destination navigation from full task completion: many tasks share the prefix of reaching the right page, while final actions may enter content, send data, make purchases, delete information, or change sensitive settings. To evaluate route finding without downstream execution confounds, we introduce DestBench, a navigation-only protocol that asks whether an agent reaches the correct pre-action destination screen. DestBench enables a controlled graph-memory study comparing no-memory agents with random, automated BFS, and clean graph memory. Graph-derived memory improves strict navigation success rate of UI-TARS-1.5-7B from 52.4% without graph memory to 58.3% with automated BFS memory, and improves Qwen-VL-Max success rate from 59.5% to 71.4% on the same conditions. Together, TAG-Nav and DestBench show that destination coverage and route cleanliness strongly shape graph-memory value, making graph quality a measured variable rather than an assumed benefit of exploration.

papers.title_en: Agentic In-Context Learning: What Algorithms Can Transformers Learn in Closed-Loop Interaction?
papers.authors: Shiguang Wu, Yaqing Wang, Quanming Yao
papers.evidence: 形式化语言模型智能体的闭环交互学习
papers.tldr: 传统上下文学习依赖外部样例，而智能体的行动会决定后续获得的证据，形成闭环学习。本文提出智能体式上下文学习，以状态、更新和决策规则统一描述主动学习、多臂老虎机与在线强化学习，并构造有限时域内近似执行这些算法的因果Transformer。实验表明，模型能学会三类代表性递推，不同奖励会诱导不同决策策略。研究进一步刻画过程奖励保持最终结果最优行为的条件，为理解智能体学到何种交互算法提供框架。
papers.abstract_en: The learning algorithm view of in-context learning (ICL) studies how fixed-parameter Transformers learn from supplied examples. Language model agents extend this setting through interaction: their actions determine what evidence enters context next. We call this regime Agentic In-Context Learning (Agentic ICL). Existing studies largely depend on externally supplied contexts or reward-bearing interaction histories, while work on general tool-using agents lacks a learning algorithm view. We represent an interactive learner by its state, update, and decision rule, covering active learning, bandits, and online reinforcement learning (RL). For expressivity, we construct causal Transformers that approximate these algorithms over a finite horizon, and bound the resulting loss in return. For training, we characterize when optimizing process rewards preserves behavior that maximizes the final outcome. Distillation experiments show that Transformers can learn to execute three representative recursions. We then train models from outcome or process rewards without oracle action or state targets, as in RL post-training. Different rewards yield distinct decision policies. Improving the alignment of process supervision with outcome-optimal action preferences shifts learned decisions accordingly. Such behavioral differences persist in a pretrained language model across textual paraphrases.

papers.title_en: OfficeTown: Generative Organizations for Evolving Agent Intelligence
papers.authors: Hongchen Wei, Daohong Ying, Zhi Hong, Aidan Wu, Bei Liu, Ruichun Ma, Yifan Yang, Qi Dai, Kai Qiu, Rui Xu, Dongdong Chen, Zhenzhong Chen, Chong Luo
papers.evidence: 模拟工作场景中的任务委托、协作及对助手成果的审阅
papers.tldr: 专业智能体需要利用持续积累的文件、决策和反馈，而孤立任务难以体现真实工作依赖。OfficeTown从自然语言描述生成持续运行的组织，通过成员协作、任务委派和交付审查产生训练与评测资源。其基准覆盖23个组织、8个领域，包含406项任务和4836条评价标准；相关数据训练显著提升了Qwen3.5-9B在GDPval等外部基准上的表现。研究表明，组织模拟可为通用智能体提供贴近专业工作的持续数据来源。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents increasingly use files and software tools to produce professional deliverables. Such work draws on materials, decisions, and feedback accumulated across assignments. We introduce OfficeTown, a generative simulation framework for professional organizations in which tasks and their context arise from continuing organizational work. From a natural-language description of an organization's purpose and activities, OfficeTown initializes an organization whose members coordinate work, delegate bounded assignments to assistant agents, and review their deliverables. Artifacts, decisions, and unresolved matters persist and shape subsequent work, while responsibilities and permissions determine what each member can see and do. We curate work requests, their context, and review feedback into executable resources for evaluation and learning. We construct OfficeTown Bench with 406 tasks and 4,836 evaluation criteria from 23 simulated organizations across eight professional domains, incorporating domain-expert feedback. Frontier-model evaluations reveal substantial remaining headroom. Supervised fine-tuning and on-policy distillation on OfficeTown data substantially improve Qwen3.5-9B on external professional-work benchmarks, including GDPval. Supplementary evaluations show that the principal--assistant harness achieves higher scores than the single- and multi-agent baselines tested. These results highlight the value of organizational simulation in generating work-grounded data and environments for the continued development of generalist agents.

papers.title_en: Interactive Navigation Beyond Reachability: Benchmark and Agentic Framework
papers.authors: Delun Li, Xueyao Wei, Rui Chen, Yifei Wang, Junzhi Yu, Wenjie Song, Xingyu Chen
papers.evidence: 评测具身智能体通过与物体和环境交互完成导航
papers.tldr: 传统具身导航通常假设通路与物体状态固定，难以处理开门进入房间、再打开容器寻找隐藏目标的连续交互。论文提出交互式导航任务与含3000个回合的MultINav-Bench，覆盖通路、容器及混合任务，并标注交互是否必要。其智能体以持久化、状态条件化交互图连接语义感知、动作决策与交互后验证，在三类任务上均优于适配基线。该工作将空间连通性、目标可见性及其顺序依赖纳入统一评测与决策框架。
papers.abstract_en: Existing embodied navigation tasks commonly assume that traversability and object states remain fixed during an episode. Yet reaching a goal may require opening a door to access a room and then opening a container to reveal a hidden target. We formulate interactive navigation beyond reachability, unifying channel-induced changes in spatial connectivity, container-induced changes in target visibility, and their sequential dependencies. We introduce MultINav-Bench, a 3K-episode ObjectGoal benchmark in MolmoSpaces spanning channel, container, and mixed tasks, with interaction-necessity annotations covering required and unnecessary episodes. Its data generation pipeline automates task construction across multiple task types. The evaluation protocol separately measures navigation success, interaction effectiveness, and cost. We further propose MultINav-Agent, a three-stage agentic framework built on a persistent, state-conditioned interaction graph. Semantic interactive perception grounds entities and interaction states; a vision-language model selects task-relevant actions based on expected changes in connectivity and target observability; and post-interaction verification updates the graph to guide subsequent navigation, exploration, or interaction. Experiments on MultINav-Bench show that MultINav-Agent consistently outperforms adapted baselines across channel, container, and mixed tasks.

papers.title_en: Beyond Belief Nesting: Rethinking Higher-Order Theory of Mind in Large Language Models
papers.authors: Shanshan You, Zhengqi Wang, Hao Liu, Yuqin Liu, Ya He, Xin Hao, Liyuan Wang
papers.evidence: 研究支撑沟通与协调的LLM心智理论推理能力
papers.tldr: 现有高阶心智理论评测常把信念嵌套层数当作推理阶数，导致低阶捷径夸大模型能力。研究以各层信念依赖的独立事件界定有效阶数，构建严格验证阶数的HopToM，并提出结构化记录视角、确定性求解的HopTrace。四个前沿模型直接作答时，准确率从一阶73.5%降至四阶20.0%；新方法使四、五阶准确率分别提升22.0和38.5个百分点。研究为高阶视角推理提供了更严格的评测与高效改进路径。
papers.abstract_en: Theory of mind (ToM), the ability to reason about others' mental states, underlies effective communication and coordination. Its higher-order form enables reasoning over nested perspectives in strategic interactions. However, existing evaluations often equate belief-nesting depth with reasoning order, allowing nominally higher-order questions to admit lower-order shortcuts. We formalize effective order through the distinct events supporting successive belief prefixes, revealing widespread order inflation across existing benchmarks. We introduce HopToM, with certified full-order questions and controls for lower-order alternatives. Under direct prompting, mean accuracy across four frontier LLMs falls from 73.5% at first order to 20.0% at fourth order, and human participants also struggle. Causal interventions link a recurring class of errors to evidence for shallower belief prefixes. We introduce HopTrace, a plug-and-play inference-time method that encodes each interaction once into perspective records and resolves nested queries deterministically. On certified narrative questions, it improves fourth- and fifth-order accuracy by 22.0 and 38.5 percentage points over strong prompting baselines, while using 20-39 times fewer tokens than multi-call methods. These results sharpen how higher-order ToM is evaluated and offer a practical way to improve perspective reasoning in interactive agents.

papers.title_en: Agentic Robot Creation through Generation, Verification, and Revision
papers.authors: Xuebing Li, Yibo He, Sitong Liu, Ran Ji, Jiayuan Gu
papers.evidence: 智能体将用户任务意图转化为机器人设计与可执行行为
papers.tldr: 从高层用户意图创造机器人，既要保证机械结构可制造，也要让期望动作可执行。论文提出制造前的机械设计计算评估指标，并构建RoboForge框架，通过动作生成、策略学习和执行反馈，迭代修改参考动作与奖励。多模态模型评估揭示了生成设计中反复出现的机械缺陷，四类机器人的实验表明闭环修订能改善任务行为与执行质量。作者还制造了智能体生成的大猩猩机器人并直接部署所学行为，展示了连接设计验证与行为学习的可行路径。
papers.abstract_en: Can an AI agent turn high-level user intent into a functioning robot and teach it how to behave? We study this question from two complementary aspects: embodiment and behavior creation. For embodiment creation, we investigate how well current multimodal models capture mechanical requirements, and introduce computational metrics for evaluating generated designs before fabrication. For behavior creation, we present Roboforge, an agentic framework that turns task specifications into executable policies through motion generation, policy learning, and execution-grounded revision. Given a robot embodiment and task, the agent generates a reference motion, configures the learning objective, and trains a policy. Crucially, motion remains in the loop: rollout feedback can revise the reference motion, reward, or both. We evaluate a generated embodiment across multiple MLLMs and behavior creation across four diverse robots against reward-refinement and one-shot motion baselines. Our computational metrics expose recurring mechanical failures in generated designs, while behavior experiments show that execution-grounded refinement improves task-level behavior and execution quality. Finally, we fabricate an agent-generated Gorilla and directly deploy learned behaviors on the physical robot.

papers.title_en: Understanding the "Why": Investigating the Design of Privacy Support Tools (PSTs) through the Lens of Psychological Needs
papers.authors: Sara Hahn, Verena Zimmermann, Simon Althaus, Andreas Heinemann, Ephraim Zimmer, Alina Stöver, Nina Gerber
papers.evidence: 研究以用户需求为中心设计隐私控制工具
papers.tldr: 隐私支持工具旨在帮助用户控制数字数据，但用户的无力感与信息过载阻碍了工具采用，法规强化控制权也未能消除隐私管理困难。研究以心理需求为理论视角，通过对15名用户开展深入访谈，探索支持长期采用的设计方向。结果识别出安全感、自主性与胜任感三项关键需求，强调工具设计应关注用户使用背后的动机。论文据此提出面向心理需求的设计启示与建议，为隐私支持工具的持续使用提供参考。
papers.abstract_en: Privacy Support Tools (PSTs) help users control their digital data, but face low adoption due to resignation and overwhelm. While current regulations aim to enhance privacy control, users still struggle to manage their privacy. To address this, we explore how PSTs can be designed for long-term adoption by applying the theoretical lens of psychological needs, as their fulfillment motivates users to use a digital product. We conducted in-depth interviews with 15 users and identified Security, Autonomy, and Competence as key psychological needs. From our results, we derive implications and recommendations for the need-sensitive design of PSTs.

papers.title_en: Jev-ToM: Evaluating Theory of Mind in Typed Decision Models
papers.authors: Kawai Chung, Chunkit Chan, Yuxuan Liu, Yauwai Yim, Xi Yang, Wenbin Hu, Huihao Jing, Chiu Yeung Tang, Changxuan Fan, Ki Sen Hung, Tsun On Kwok, Haoran Li
papers.evidence: 研究对话与协作助手所需的心智状态判断
papers.tldr: 对话助手需要反复判断伙伴的知识、信念与意图，生成式模型的调用成本推动了替代方案探索。Jev-ToM在九个基准、六类能力的11117道英文题上，比较五种类型化决策模型与七个生成式基线。TypeSafe Jev的来源均衡准确率达73.2%，六类能力均位列前二，资源比较也显示降本提速潜力。但置信度、理由附加方式及候选扩展均影响可靠性，提示其适合作为助手中的有限候选选择组件，而非直接替代完整对话系统。
papers.abstract_en: Dialogue and collaborative assistants repeatedly judge what a partner knows, believes, or intends. Typed decision models offer a potential alternative to generative large language models for bounded Theory of Mind (ToM) selection. We present Jev-ToM, comparing five typed decision models and seven generative baselines on 11,117 English text questions from nine ToM benchmarks across six capability groups. TypeSafe Jev reaches 73.2% source-balanced accuracy including native controls and ranks first or second across all six capabilities, leading beliefs, goals/desires/intentions, and emotions. Other typed models show distinct strengths across tasks. Separate resource comparisons suggest that Jev could reduce the cost and waiting time of repeated ToM selection. Confidence-based selection remains benchmark-dependent, and supplied reasons can repair errors or overturn correct answers depending on their attachment. Candidate expansion reveals distinct selection and output-validity problems. Related-question cues account for most of Jev's downstream gains, with task-dependent effects from predicted states. The findings motivate testing Jev as a ToM selection component in assistants, with task-specific confidence calibration, candidate design, and output validation as integration priorities.

papers.title_en: EmbodiedEvo: Self-improving Coding Agents for Physical Intelligence
papers.authors: Wenyi Li, Yizhe Chi, Youjie Zheng, Chunyu Liu, Xiaoqiu Wang, Mingju Gao, Zheng Jiang, Deyao Hong, Calvin Xiao, Kaisen Yang, Qinhuai Na
papers.evidence: 智能体依据物理环境反馈自主修订并执行代码
papers.tldr: 面向物理任务的编码智能体虽能自主修改和执行控制代码，却容易反复遭遇相似失败。EmbodiedEvo在单个练习场景中依据执行反馈积累可复用技能与经验教训，再冻结智能体运行框架并迁移至新场景。在RoboDojo-Sim上，其成功率达37.82%，超越全部官方验证结果；相比保留原始交互历史，执行成本降低53.0%。结果表明，结构化经验可支持跨场景复用及强模型向弱模型的能力迁移，但精细接触控制仍是难点。
papers.abstract_en: Bringing general-purpose agents into the physical world calls for an executable representation of physical intelligence. Compared with vision-language-action (VLA) models, which map observations and language instructions directly to actions, code makes control logic explicit and reusable. Code can serve not only as a policy representation but also as the workspace in which the agent solves a task. Rather than following a prescribed workflow of planning, execution, and verification, the agent can autonomously inspect the state, revise and execute code, and use feedback to choose the next step. The success of this SWE-style loop in digital environments motivates its extension to physical tasks. Yet physical execution remains prone to recurring failures. To retain and refine experience for later scenes, we introduce EmbodiedEvo, where a coding agent evolves reusable Skills and Lessons through feedback on a single Playground scene, then freezes the resulting harness for diverse new scenes. On RoboDojo-Sim, EmbodiedEvo achieves an average score of 44.48 and a success rate of 37.82\%, surpassing all officially verified results. Paired tests show the largest gains on memory-dependent tasks and successful reuse of coordinated procedures, while fine contact control remains difficult. Experience from stronger models also improves weaker executors: Astra's experience raises Sol and Luna's success rates by 8.86 and 5.50 percentage points over no experience. Compared with raw interaction history, Skills and Lessons achieve comparable task performance at 53.0\% lower execution cost.
